group.name: CLI Menu (main.py) <-> Input <-> Processing <-> Visualization
group.modules: main.py (menu)  ->  input_module.py  ->  processing.py  ->  linked_list / bst / stack_queue / sorting / graph  ->  visualizer.py
group.strategy: Top-Down Integration: the top-level menu (main.py) is tested end-to-end through all lower modules using real keyboard input (stdin).
group.dataPassed: stdin keystrokes -> menu choice + raw text -> parsed values -> data structures/algorithms -> rendered text on stdout

cases.title: Sorting menu: quick sort + binary search
cases.objective: Verify the complete program: user keystrokes flow through every module and the right output is printed
cases.pre: Python 3 installed; run from project root
cases.steps: 1. Start `python main.py`  2. Send keystrokes from Test Data  3. Check printed output
cases.expected: output contains "After (quick sort)" and "Binary search: found at index 2"
cases.actual: After (quick sort): | Search for a value (blank to skip): Binary search: found at index 2
